name: practonaut
description: Local practice gym for AI agents on real apps: demonstrate a task once, let any MCP agent practice it, get an independent reproducible score.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run schema:check && npm run docs:check && npm run design:contrast && npm run design:lint && npm run library:check && npm run registry:check
scripts.test:a11y: npm run engine:build && npm run player:build && node --import ./tests/support/test-home.ts tools/test-player-a11y.ts --gate-create
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/build-engine.ts --dist && node tools/build-player.ts --dist
scripts.test:integration: npm run engine:build && npm run player:build && node --import ./tests/support/test-home.ts --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-timeout=480000 --test-reporter=spec "tests/integration/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run engine:build && npm run player:build && node --import ./tests/support/test-home.ts --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-timeout=300000 --test-reporter=spec "tests/e2e/*.test.ts" && node --import ./tests/support/test-home.ts --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=600000 --test-reporter=spec "tests/e2e/timing/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:mcp: npm run engine:build && npm run player:build && node --import ./tests/support/test-home.ts --test --test-timeout=180000 --test-reporter=spec "tests/mcp/*.test.ts"
